name: gradient-free-optimizers-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Gradient-Free-Optimizers (the `gradient_free_optimizers` Python
package): a library of derivative-free optimization algorithms (hill climbing and its variants,
simulated annealing, pattern search, Powell's method, DIRECT, grid and random search, particle
swarm, evolutionary and other population methods, and sequential model-based optimizers) that
search continuous, categorical, discrete and SciPy-distribution search spaces through a managed
`search()` loop or an ask/tell interface, with initialization strategies, constraints, boundary
handling, memory, stopping conditions, callbacks and a `search_data` record of every evaluation.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the gradient_free_optimizers package under src/gradient_free_optimizers/ other than its test package optimizers/tests/, the pure-Python fallback backends _array_backend/_pure.py and _math_backend/_pure.py and the Dask and Ray distribution backends _distributed/_dask.py and _distributed/_ray.py, together with README.md, every page under docs/source/get_started/, docs/source/user_guide/ and docs/source/faq/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
